story-context.title: Capability Snapshot Prompt Cleanup
story-context.overview: Remove the orphaned Form AI prompt-section bundle, complete the capability parity audit that gates all future capability-snapshot mutation, lock the active capability snapshot prompt behavior with tests, document current FormSemanticPlan backward compatibility, and re-run the 6.4.3a baseline.

critical-objectives.item: Delete system_prompt_sections_1_6.py and move tests to the active prompt assembly path.
Complete the capability parity audit before changing capability prompt behavior.
Make active generation prompt assembly include ALLOWED COMPONENT TYPES whenever a snapshot exists.
Preserve missing-snapshot legacy fallback for replay/dev, but do not treat it as normal configured operation.
Document FormSemanticPlan compatibility decisions in an ADR before later schema/style work.
Re-run the prompts-v1.0 baseline and compare against Story 6.4.3a structural metrics.

dependencies.story: Complete; provides prompts-v1.0 harness and baseline artifact.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic commands. If audit requires a snapshot repair migration, Anthony applies it.
Do NOT change H1/H2/H4 prompt content in this story.
Do NOT modify prompts.yaml except to read it through the harness.
Do NOT implement judge package, rubric, ingest, stats, or CI comment tooling.
Do NOT add new active component capabilities unless the parity audit proves a currently active snapshot is invalid and SM approves the repair.
